Independently enumerated EVERY upper-triangular adjacency mask (topological labelling exists for any DAG), n=1..6 mask counts 1,2,8,64,1024,32768, synchronizing colors across all same-n graphs and exactly deduplicating by directed isomorphism preserving stable colors. Recovered unlabeled DAG types 1,2,6,31,302,5984 and directed-WL/C2 buckets 1,2,6,31,302,5983, precisely one bucket with two nonisomorphic types at n6. Explicit witnesses have two oriented-transitive triangles versus a connected 6-cycle with sources/intermediate/sinks; each quotient class has two vertices, neighbor-color signatures identical while underlying connectivity proves nonisomorphism. The full exact exhaustive enumeration and finite-class completeness are independent of packaged logs and prove the n<=6 assertion; no assertion about n>=7.
